Dragon Frontiers

Released November 1, 2006 · 101 cards

Dragon Frontiers is a Pokémon TCG expansion in the EX series, released in English on November 1, 2006. It has 101 cards. It includes 83 Pokémon, 12 Trainer and 6 Energy cards, and is not legal in Standard or Expanded.

Illustrators

25 illustrators worked on Dragon Frontiers. Most cards: Kouki Saitou (9), Ken Sugimori (8), Hajime Kusajima (7), Hisao Nakamura (6), Yukiko Baba (6), Midori Harada (5), Shizurow (5), Takumi Akabane (5).
